objective: Al terminar expresas obligación, prohibición y permiso en registro formal (be required to, be obliged to, be permitted to, be prohibited from) y entiendes normas y avisos.

warmup.prompt_es: Los contratos, reglamentos y avisos usan un inglés más formal que 'must' y 'can't'. Entenderlo y usarlo te permite leer normas y redactar instrucciones con precisión.

text: All tenants are required to pay rent on or before the first day of each month. Failure to do so may result in a late fee. Tenants are obliged to keep the property in good condition and must report any damage within 48 hours.

Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the building. Pets are not permitted without the landlord's written consent. Residents are not allowed to sublet the flat, and they are expected to respect their neighbours by avoiding excessive noise after 10 p.m.
The landlord is entitled to enter the property for inspections, provided that at least 24 hours' notice is given. In an emergency, however, access may be gained without prior notice.

Tenants who wish to terminate the contract must give three months' written notice. Those who leave early will be liable for any outstanding rent. No deposit will be refunded unless the property is returned in its original condition.
It is compulsory to have contents insurance. Visitors are permitted to stay for up to two weeks; longer stays require prior approval.
input.es: Términos y condiciones para inquilinos. Todos los inquilinos deben pagar el alquiler el primer día de cada mes o antes. El incumplimiento puede dar lugar a un recargo por demora. Los inquilinos están obligados a mantener la propiedad en buen estado y deben comunicar cualquier daño en 48 horas. Está terminantemente prohibido fumar en el interior del edificio. No se permiten mascotas sin el consentimiento escrito del propietario. Los residentes no pueden subarrendar el piso y se espera que respeten a los vecinos evitando ruidos excesivos después de las 22:00. El propietario tiene derecho a entrar en la propiedad para inspecciones, siempre que se avise con al menos 24 horas de antelación. En caso de emergencia, sin embargo, podrá accederse sin previo aviso. Los inquilinos que deseen rescindir el contrato deben avisar por escrito con tres meses de antelación. Quienes se marchen antes serán responsables del alquiler pendiente. No se devolverá ninguna fianza a menos que la propiedad se devuelva en su estado original. Es obligatorio tener un seguro de contenido. Se permite que las visitas se queden hasta dos semanas; estancias más largas requieren aprobación previa.

md_es: **Obligación, prohibición y permiso: registro formal**
| Función | Informal | Formal |
| **Obligación** | *must, have to* | *be required to, be obliged to, be compelled to, it is compulsory / mandatory to* |
| **Prohibición** | *mustn't, can't* | *be prohibited from, be forbidden to, be not permitted to, it is forbidden to* |
| **Permiso** | *can, may* | *be permitted to, be allowed to, be entitled to, be authorised to* |
| **Falta de obligación** | *don't have to, needn't* | *be not required to, it is not necessary to, there is no obligation to* |
| **Expectativa** | *should* | *be expected to, be supposed to* |
**Estructuras**
- *Tenants are required to pay rent.* · *Smoking is prohibited / not permitted.* · *Pets are not allowed.* · *Visitors are permitted to stay for two weeks.*
- *Failure to pay may result in a fine.* (consecuencia) · *Anyone who breaks the rules will be liable for …*
**Matices**
- *Must* (obligación personal) vs *have to* (obligación externa) vs *be required to* (norma oficial).
- *Mustn't* = prohibido; *don't have to* = no es necesario. ✘ *You mustn't wear a tie (no obligation).* → ✔ *You don't have to wear a tie.*
- *Be allowed to* = permiso general; *can* = capacidad o permiso informal.
**Avisos y carteles**
- *No smoking. · Keep off the grass. · Authorised personnel only. · Do not enter. · Pull to open. · Mind the gap.*
- Estructura típica: *Passengers are requested to remain seated.* · *Visitors must report to reception.*
**Pasiva e impersonales en normas**
- *It is forbidden to use phones during the exam.* · *Candidates are not permitted to leave early.* · *Eating and drinking are not allowed.*
**Errores típicos**
- ✘ *You are required pay.* → ✔ *You are required to pay.*
- ✘ *It is prohibited to smoke inside the building.* (aceptable) pero ✘ *It prohibits smoking.* → ✔ *Smoking is prohibited.*
- ✘ *You don't must enter.* → ✔ *You mustn't enter.* / *You don't have to enter.*
- ✘ *I am obliged of pay.* → ✔ *I am obliged to pay.*
- ✘ *The rules forbid to smoke.* → ✔ *The rules forbid smoking.* / *The rules forbid us to smoke.*

**Ojo:** *Forbid + persona + to + verbo* (*forbid us to enter*) vs *prohibit + -ing* (*prohibit smoking*) / *prohibit someone from + -ing*. *Allow + persona + to* / *allow + -ing*: *They don't allow smoking. · They don't allow us to smoke.*
Pronunciación: *obliged* /əˈblaɪdʒd/ · *sublet* /ˌsʌbˈlet/ · *liable* /ˈlaɪəbl/ · *compulsory* /kəmˈpʌlsəri/.
